description: This file defines the EmpUsTaxExemptionService class, which provides a service layer for managing US tax exemption data within the OrangeHRM system. It primarily contains a private property for an EmpUsTaxExemptionDao object and a getter method to instantiate or retrieve it.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionService
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling operations related to US tax exemptions in the HRM system.

methods.name: getEmpUsTaxExemptionDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmpUsTaxExemptionDao, creating it if it has not been instantiated yet.
